title: The cross-provider payment journey (Flutterwave-only sender → Stripe-only merchant)
source: The operator's P20-order journey (session web-a95c8999, 2026-10-27): New Task → model/difficulty → 'Pay merchant X' → typed intent → pinned routine → stage-by-stage progress → provider-evidenced rails → routes/counterfactuals/opportunities → authorization → real execution or honest no-route. Plus the P20-closure carry-forwards 'the provider execution lanes (operator credentials required)' and 'live-provider route evidence (zero connected capability instances)' — UNBLOCKED: the operator supplied fresh test-mode credentials (station-secret-store only).
policy: Register only. No P21 implementation or acceptance is claimed by the graph. The operator's order label 'P20' registers as P21 (the repo's P20 is closed; 'e.g.' is not a mandate; P14–P20 history is never rewritten); the follow-on provider-combination redo (Stellar + Paystack; GHS→USDC(Stellar)→KES) is P22, registered only after P21 closes (no Stellar adapter exists today — chain families: EVM, SOLANA, UTXO, MOVE, COSMOS, SUBSTRATE, OTHER). The six truth facts stay machine-enforced: catalogue≠connected, connected≠eligible, FLW-probe≠send, Stripe-test-PM≠FLW-funded, scripted≠provider-evidence, acceptance≠settlement. The honest outcome for the ordered FLW→Stripe intent is NO_ROUTE (no FLW send operation is implemented and none is manufactured — an FLW transfer terminates at bank/MOMO destinations and would not create an FLW→Stripe route; the frozen route-shape vocabulary gains no cross-provider fiat composition this wave). The revise path (the user's persisted revision option) exercises the complete operator §7 path over the REAL Stripe kernel (SANDBOX-only, behind the lane resolver + authorization gate, funding facts honestly TEST_DATA — never an FLW-funded claim). Secrets stay in the station secret store; the credential-seal path is the only key conduit; receipts are machine-scanned.

Journey lane (app + renderer composition, disjoint from P21-A's mirror files): the channel-backed session port (the composer's PAYMENT_MISSION intents seed REAL missions; the ask/capture loop in the composer conversation; web keeps the honest localStorage tier) + the stage-progress panel (derived from persisted typed events + the engine view; the ROUTINE_PINNED task event) + the model/difficulty controls (REAL substrate catalogs; retention + restore; the difficulty→budget mapping; the honest no-narration-tier disclosure) + the wait controls (re-check/cancel) + the Connections UI for the new members. TL integration: the bridge battery (the full journey through the REAL channel incl. the revise path's REAL dispatch + authoritative read-back) + the E2E law (the web tier via journey-verification + the NEW Electron CDP desktop harness; screenshots + structured secret-free receipts) + the provider receipts with the fresh credentials + the integrated batteries + the architecture check + the JOURNEY-MAP/FEATURE-MAP reconciliation + the graph closure + the current-state closure + PUSH + the bundle archive + the honest carry-forward record (P22; the CLI-agent skill/MCP candidate; the automatic evidence feeds; the protocol-plane bridge).

closure_policy: P21 closes only when P21-A/B/C/D are all accepted on main with their batteries green at the tip AND the journey is proven end-to-end at the user level: either a genuine route executed and reconciled with provider evidence, or the correct tested NO_ROUTE outcome with evidence-backed conditional opportunities and the durable wait/revise choice — in either case the New Task → terminal-state journey proven against the real application (the CDP desktop tier + the web tier), with the six truth facts still machine-enforced and zero secret material in any artifact. No mock route, synthetic funding claim, fixture-only CONFIRMED, LLM-authored score or unsupported 'payment completed' claim may satisfy the gate.
